notes: NEEDS RULING: «قلت لسعيد بن المسيب بلغني أن جابر بن عبد الله كان يقول كانوا أربع عشرة مائة» is a second saying with its own gap («بلغني», rule 8); it is not written as a route here (rule 11)
The route of the saying written is Qatada asking Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, who answers «حدثني جابر» (rule 5), so Jabir is the last link
«قال أبو داود حدثنا قرة عن قتادة» gives a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route (rule 4)
